status: proposed observation contracts grounded in static source; no runtime handoff has been verified

contracts.applicability: single text request, greedy decoding, one completion

framework_translation.vllm: OutputProcessor records external_req_id to internal request_id; EngineCore receives the internal request_id
framework_translation.sglang: TokenizerManager records rid and sends the tokenized request with that rid to Scheduler

contracts.decision: The scheduler record belongs to the admitted request and preserves its normalized input and sampling parameters.

contracts.applicability: single scheduled request and one completion; batch-row association must be recorded if batching is enabled
contracts.join_key: request ID plus scheduled token position

framework_translation.vllm: SchedulerOutput is passed to the model executor in EngineCore.step
framework_translation.sglang: Scheduler constructs the forward batch and invokes model_worker.forward_batch_generation

contracts.decision: The model row and positions correspond to the scheduler decision for the same request.

framework_translation.vllm: EngineCore updates scheduler state from the model output before returning EngineCoreOutputs
framework_translation.sglang: Batch result processing emits per-request output rows after the model worker returns

required_observations: request ID for each output row
contracts.decision: The output token and finish state originate from the model step of the same request.

contracts.applicability: non-streaming final response; streaming chunks require an additional ordering contract
contracts.join_key: internal request ID mapped to client-visible request ID

framework_translation.vllm: RequestState maps internal request_id to external_req_id; RequestOutput exposes external_req_id
framework_translation.sglang: Batch output retains rid through detokenization; TokenizerManager looks up rid_to_state[rid]

contracts.decision: The client response is the final output of the admitted request, with the expected token order and terminal reason.

contracts.applicability: request is running when cancellation is accepted
contracts.join_key: cancel target identity plus accepted-cancel event order

framework_translation.vllm: External ID can identify several internal requests; EngineCore processes queued aborts before updating the completed model step
framework_translation.sglang: TokenizerManager forwards rid; Scheduler marks running request to_finish=FINISH_ABORT and may execute one further decode step

contracts.decision: The accepted cancellation targets the intended running request; normal completion that precedes cancellation is recorded separately.

contracts.applicability: cancellation accepted before an in-flight model result is returned
contracts.join_key: cancelled request identity plus event order

framework_translation.vllm: OutputProcessor ignores EngineCoreOutput when request_states no longer contains its internal ID
framework_translation.sglang: TokenizerManager ignores a batch output whose rid is absent from rid_to_state

contracts.decision: After effective cancellation, the in-flight result produces no later normal client-visible response for that request.

contracts.applicability: running request owns resources while work may still be in flight
contracts.join_key: request identity plus resource identity and last-use event

framework_translation.vllm: Scheduler can defer block freeing until the step that may use it completes
framework_translation.sglang: Running-request abort can execute one further decode forward before normal KV cleanup

contracts.decision: A resource is not reused before its last possible use and is released once outstanding uses and references end.
